# Kseniia Shermin

> Performance Marketing Manager with 10+ years of hands-on paid search experience. Manages Google Ads and Microsoft Ads accounts spending over $100,000/day, plus Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads. Focused on lead generation for B2C, B2B, and service businesses.

Industries: health insurance (ACA, U65, Medicare O65), life and final expense insurance, auto and home insurance, mental health and behavioral health treatment, telecom and internet service providers, e-commerce (home appliances and consumer goods), and B2B SaaS.

Full page text (for systems that prefer complete source over summaries): https://kseniiashermin.com/llms-full.txt

## Pages

- [Home](https://kseniiashermin.com/): Overview, platform expertise (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads), and industries served.
- [Case Studies](https://kseniiashermin.com/case-studies/): Real account results, including a 5X lead gen scale-up in health insurance, a 90-day launch for a mental health brand, a 25X vertical scale-up in insurance lead gen, and 36X order growth in e-commerce.
- [Blog](https://kseniiashermin.com/blog/): Articles on paid search and PPC, written from hands-on account management.
  - [Microsoft Ads vs Google Ads: Cost, Competition, and Bot Traffic (2026 Data)](https://kseniiashermin.com/blog/microsoft-ads-vs-google-ads/): CPC, conversion rate, and cost-per-conversion benchmarks for both platforms, plus the bot-traffic and invalid-click risk that comes with Microsoft Ads' thinner auction, from someone running both platforms on accounts spending over $100,000/day.
- [Work With Me](https://kseniiashermin.com/services/): Audits, consultations, and ongoing account management for Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and Meta Ads, plus FAQ on budget, e-commerce, platforms, and industries.
- [For Employers](https://kseniiashermin.com/for-employers/): Background for hiring managers considering Kseniia for a full-time or fractional Performance Marketing Manager role.
- [About](https://kseniiashermin.com/about/): Full career history and client testimonials.
- [Contact](https://kseniiashermin.com/contact/): Contact form and direct booking link.
